about.title: About the Primal Clash set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Primal Clash is a XY expansion released on 4 February 2015. It has 164 cards: 160 in the main set and 4 secret rares. There are also 132 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 160 main set cards), the Master set (292 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 296 cards, adding the 4 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
